title: 实义词：搭配
goal: 依据常见搭配和句意补出实义词，并区分动词、名词和修饰语。
exam: TOEFL iBT（2026 年 1 月起的新版）· 阅读

points.label: 根据搭配补出动词或名词
根据搭配补出形容词、副词

body.p: 搭配是经常连在一起使用的词。play a role 中的动词是 play。reach a conclusion 表示得出结论，其中的 reach 不能换成别的搭配里的动词。

body.box: The committee reached a conclusion after reviewing the evidence.

body.p: 搭配能缩小候选词的范围，但有时不止一个词合适。significant increase 和 gradual increase 都成立。这时看句子说的是幅度还是速度，再核对已给字母和词长。

cards.title: 动词与名词
rows: Training can play a role in improving accuracy. The trial will take place indoors.
Lighting can have an effect on color judgments. The team reached a conclusion after the final test.
The group conducts research on handwriting. Volunteers collect data at each crossing.
The photographs provide evidence of damage. The unexpected result poses a question about the model.
The report makes a distinction between cost and price. The diagram draws attention to the narrow opening.

cards.title: 形容词与名词
rows: The records show a significant increase in attendance. Distance is a major factor in transport costs.
Repeated measurements provide reliable evidence. Lower maintenance costs are a potential benefit.
A central courtyard is a common feature of these plans. The sequence shows a gradual change in shape.
明确区别；有限的使用机会或进入权限
There is a clear distinction between the two categories. Visitors have limited access to the storage area.
A detailed analysis examines every entry. The results show a consistent pattern across trials.

cards.title: 副词搭配
rows: 广泛使用的；密切相关的
This notation is widely used in the department. The two measures are closely related.
非常有效的；容易获得的
The filter proved highly effective at removing dust. Replacement parts are readily available.
相对稳定的；直接相关的
The indoor temperature remained relatively stable. Each entry is directly linked to its source.
主要依赖的；受到仔细控制的
The outcome is largely dependent on the initial settings. Room temperature was carefully controlled.
迅速变化的；得到有力支持的
The study concerns a rapidly changing neighborhood. The interpretation is strongly supported by the records.

cards.title: 名词与介词
rows: The study examines the effect on attendance. The record provides evidence for this interpretation.
使用或进入……的机会；……的增加
Students have access to the equipment. There was an increase in the number of visitors.
There is a difference between the two estimates. The variable has a relationship with the final score.
The archive makes a contribution to local history. Demand for evening classes has grown.
对……的依赖；……方面的变化或差异
The new design reduces dependence on batteries. The study records variation in handwriting size.

body.box: The report draws atte_____ to a sharp rise in repairs. The rise is a signi______ increase, not a minor fluctuation.

body.p: draw attention 表示引起注意，atte_____ 补 ntion。后一句把 sharp rise 与 minor fluctuation 对比，signi______ 补 ficant，形成 significant increase。
两个空都要核对整组搭配。attention 是 draws 的宾语。significant 修饰 increase，说明增加的幅度大。

groups.label: Read the text.
groups.text: A handwriting study needs observations from many writers. Assistants will ___ data from the completed forms.

items.stem: Which verb completes the phrase about obtaining observations?
items.why: 依据是 needs observations from many writers，collect data 表示收集数据。

groups.label: Read the text.
groups.text: After examining every recording, the reviewers agreed on an explanation. They were ready to reach a ___.

items.stem: Which noun completes the phrase about the agreed explanation?
items.why: 依据是 agreed on an explanation，reach a conclusion 表示得出结论。

groups.label: Read the text.
groups.text: The poster highlights the missing dates. It draws ___ to gaps in the record.

items.stem: Which noun completes the phrase about highlighting the gaps?
items.why: 依据 highlights the missing dates，draw attention to 表示使人注意到，attention 是该搭配的名词。

groups.label: Read the text.
groups.text: The cleaning process removes nearly every visible mark. In these trials it is ___ effective.

items.stem: Which modifier naturally expresses the stated degree of effectiveness?
items.why: 依据是 removes nearly every visible mark，highly effective 表示效果非常好。第一项 readily 常与 available 搭配，表示容易获得。

groups.label: Read the text.
groups.text: The replacement screws are stocked in every local shop. They are ___ available.

items.stem: Which modifier completes the phrase about easy access to the screws?
items.why: 依据是 stocked in every local shop，readily available 表示容易获得。

groups.label: Read the text.
groups.text: Humidity changes little during the test. Conditions remain relatively ___.

items.stem: Which adjective completes the phrase about the lack of change?
items.why: 依据是 changes little，relatively stable 表示相对稳定。第四项 rapid 表示迅速，与原文相反。

groups.label: Fill in the missing letters.
groups.fill: A research group examines seating arrangements in a lecture room. Distance may play a ro{le} in how clearly people see the board. The team records the eff{ect} on reading accuracy and notes vari{ation} in seat height. A deta{iled} analysis compares every row. Light levels are care{fully} controlled. The findings show a consi{stent} pattern across repeated trials. Two measurements are clo{sely} related. The group can now pro{vide} evidence for a revised plan and dr{aw} attention to a pote{ntial} benefit of wider spacing.
notes: role：play a role 表示起作用。
effect：the effect on 表示对阅读准确性的影响。
variation：variation in seat height 指座椅高度方面的差异。
detailed：detailed analysis 表示详细分析，与 compares every row 对应。
carefully：carefully controlled 表示对光照条件加以控制。
consistent：consistent pattern 指重复测试中一致的模式。
closely：closely related 表示密切相关。
provide：provide evidence 表示提供证据。
draw：draw attention to 表示引起对某事的注意。
potential：potential benefit 指调整间距可能带来的益处。

groups.label: Fill in the missing letters.
groups.fill: A team is studying reusable packaging for fragile equipment. The researchers con{duct} research on how containers survive repeated journeys. They col{lect} data from each delivery and keep loading conditions care{fully} controlled. A deta{iled} analysis examines every damaged corner. The findings pro{vide} evidence for a stronger design. Cushioning appears to play a ro{le} in preventing damage. Two measurements are clo{sely} related, and the team reports a consi{stent} pattern across trials. It can re{ach} a conclusion about the pote{ntial} benefit of adding internal supports.

groups.label: Read the text.
groups.text: A ceramics class needs to separate defects caused by shaping from defects caused by firing. The instructor asks students to make a ___ between the two sources.

items.stem: Which noun completes the phrase about separating categories?
items.why: 依据 separate defects caused by shaping from defects caused by firing，make a distinction between 表示区分两类。

groups.label: Read the text.
groups.text: A field study is scheduled for the dry season. The observations will take ___ after the site becomes accessible.

items.stem: Which noun completes the phrase about when the observations occur?
items.why: 依据 is scheduled for the dry season，take place 表示发生或举行。

groups.label: Read the text.
groups.text: The seminar identifies an unresolved problem rather than offering an answer. It will ___ a question about the accuracy of old records.

items.stem: Which verb completes the phrase about introducing the problem?
items.why: 依据 identifies an unresolved problem rather than offering an answer，pose a question 表示提出问题。

groups.label: Read the text.
groups.text: Many departments have adopted the same diagram symbols. These symbols are now ___ used throughout the institution.

items.stem: Which adverb expresses use in many places?
items.why: 依据 Many departments have adopted the same diagram symbols，widely used 表示广泛使用。

groups.label: Read the text.
groups.text: Travel costs barely affected the choice, but equipment quality determined most decisions. Quality was the ___ factor.

items.stem: Which adjective identifies the most important factor?
items.why: 依据 equipment quality determined most decisions，major factor 表示主要因素。

groups.label: Read the text.
groups.text: Each drawing was changed only slightly before the next version was made. The sequence shows a ___ change in design.

items.stem: Which adjective expresses change by small steps?
items.why: 依据 changed only slightly before the next version，gradual change 表示逐渐变化。
